source: export.monster.Monster32.initBBDC()+setAction() in 打开我开始玩.swf; sheet 4.swf chid4 Monster32. 邪.沙僧 (Evil Sha Seng), 1st link in level-4's sequential boss chain (StageListener41.start() spawns this one after a 3s delay; its destroy() spawns Monster33 next). Single unbranched constructor, isBoss=true unconditional. `isNotArrow` field defaults false and is never set true anywhere in the class, so the else-branch grid (non-arrow) is the one actually used and is what's recovered here. Row4 is a shared pose bank (jump1 col0/jump3 col1/hurt col2/hit6 col3/hit5 col4/hit11 col5); only hurt is encoded (1 frame). No dedicated dead row (alpha-fade only, like the rest of this chain) — omitted. Recovered stats in data/levels/level4.ts.
